title: ISDA Credit Support Annex Threshold Change and Collateral Call Timing
scenario_text:
It's April 18, 2026. Your credit manager forwards an email from counterparty Apex Power Marketing demanding Conduit Energy post $1.2M in collateral by April 22 under your ISDA Credit Support Annex (CSA). The collateral call cites "negative mark-to-market of $2.4M on gas swap positions as of April 15, 2026, exceeding Conduit's $1.0M threshold per CSA Section 3(a)."

You pull the executed CSA from SharePoint (dated March 2018). Section 3(a) states: "Threshold for Conduit Energy: USD $1,000,000. Minimum Transfer Amount: USD $250,000." However, buried in your Outlook Sent folder, you find an email thread from January 2025 where Apex's credit officer wrote: "Per our call, we're increasing Conduit's threshold to $1.5M given your improved credit rating (BBB+ as of Q4 2024). Amendment is in legal review, expect execution in March." Your credit manager replied: "Understood, thanks. We'll operate under $1.5M effective Feb 1 pending paperwork."

You check SharePoint's contract amendments folder - no executed amendment exists. You call Apex's back office. Their collateral management system shows Conduit's threshold as $1.0M (never updated). However, their trader mentions in passing: "Yeah, we've been using $1.5M since February. Our system is wrong but we've honored it for 15 months. Legal never finalized the paperwork but we had a deal."

Allegro shows your mark-to-market at -$2.38M on April 15. SAP credit monitoring has been flagging Apex positions against a $1.5M threshold since February 2025. Your finance VP asks: "Do we legally owe this collateral by April 22?"
question: What is Conduit Energy's legally enforceable collateral obligation under the ISDA CSA as of April 18, 2026?

contributor.name: Katherine Engström
contributor.title: Power Trading Operations Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Energy market settlements, contract interpretation, counterparty risk

choices: $0 - the $2.4M mark-to-market does not exceed the $1.5M threshold agreed to in January 2025
$1.25M - calculated as ($2.4M MTM - $1.0M threshold - $250K Minimum Transfer Amount)
$1.13M - calculated as ($2.38M MTM - $1.5M threshold), rounded to Minimum Transfer Amount
$1.4M - calculated as ($2.4M MTM - $1.0M executed threshold), rounded to nearest $100K per standard practice
